card.name: Words just before a number or quantity
card.fires_on: Marked words and digits that sit right before a count, number or amount: 'of' before decimal places, a space before '1 study', or a digit inside a year. Mostly in general web text on math, history and study descriptions.

modes.label: Before a count
modes.description: A small word or space just before a number or quantity is stated.

modes.label: Inside a year
modes.description: A digit partway through a four-digit year.
modes.example: In 1<<4>>74 L was the seat of the

modes.label: Quantity words
modes.description: Words like 'of' or 'no' that lead into an amount.
modes.example: any number R with a limited number<< of>> decimal places
